title: Report accepted VCF bootstrap changes when depot sync fails
prompt:
A VCF 9.1 bootstrap workflow configures the outbound proxy, updates the supported external-service configuration, and starts depot metadata synchronization. It must preserve accepted earlier mutations when synchronization fails. Implement the standard-library-only `vcf_installer` Python package so callers receive an exact partial-progress report.

Before implementing, research the VCF 9.1 operations `updateProxyConfiguration`, `updateServicesConfig`, and `syncDepotMetadata` in official VMware sources and cite the sources consulted in the final answer.

Expose `InstallerClient`, `ProxyConfiguration`, `ServiceConfiguration`, `StepResult`, `ChangeReport`, `VCFInstallerAPIError`, and `configure_depot_access` from `vcf_installer`. Construct the client as `InstallerClient(base_url, access_token, *, timeout=10.0)`. Use only the Python standard library. Every request sends one `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>` and one `Accept: application/json`. Body-bearing requests send compact UTF-8 JSON and `Content-Type: application/json`.

`ProxyConfiguration(is_enabled, host=None, port=None, transfer_protocol=None, username=None, password=None, is_authenticated=None)` serializes only supplied writable proxy members and never sends response-only `isConfigured`. Preserve explicit false and zero values. `ServiceConfiguration(name, service_type, key, node_name, address_type, address_value)` serializes one supported `ServicesConfig` object containing one service, one node, and one address with the exact required member names.

Call the operations in this order and stop after the first failure: `PATCH /v1/system/proxy-configuration`, `PUT /v1/services-config`, then bodyless `PATCH /v1/system/settings/depot/depot-sync-info`. Require their exact success statuses respectively: HTTP 202, HTTP 200, and HTTP 202. Decode each JSON response object. A non-success raises `VCFInstallerAPIError` with the operationId, actual status, complete decoded error object, and an immutable `.completed` tuple containing the exact earlier accepted `StepResult` objects. Do not roll back or replay accepted steps. A successful workflow returns an immutable `ChangeReport.steps` tuple with all three results.

Run `python3 -B -m unittest -v tests.test_depot_bootstrap`. Do not modify tests or documentation.
scenario: updateProxyConfiguration returns live-shaped HTTP 202, updateServicesConfig returns live-shaped HTTP 200, and syncDepotMetadata returns HTTP 500; the error retains the two accepted mutations.
